name: Sustainable Business Joint Major

sections.title: Limitations for the Beedie School of Business

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students may complete either the certificate in corporate environmental and social sustainability or the sustainable business joint major program, but not both the certificate and the joint major program.

sections.title: Limitations for the School of Resource and Environmental Management

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students may complete either the sustainable development minor or the sustainable business joint major program, but not both the minor and the joint major program.

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students will complete all upper and lower division requirements for both the Beedie School of Business and the Faculty of Environment.

sections.note: The joint major is comprised of lower and upper division business core requirements, lower and upper division sustainable development core requirements, cross-disciplinary focus courses, and a capstone course.

grades.label: Grade Requirements
grades.text: In addition to normal university grade point average requirements, the Beedie School of Business requires a minimum 2.30 overall SFU Business course grade point average for entry into all 300 and 400 division business courses.

grades.label: Grade Requirements
grades.text: A minimum 2.30 overall SFU Business course grade point average is required for graduation from a business major, joint major, or double degree program.
